method: Exhaustive local control equations derived from unchanged hash_state and scalar state predicates, with basis operands and one random 64-bit operand tuple per enabled word.
scope: Local enabled-word next_word algebra plus separate real recipe/event regressions; not whole-RTL formal proof.
source_mutual_exclusion: take_fast and take_feedback belong to different hash_state modes
ordinary advanced-state source requires HASH_RUN and !take_feedback
clear_stream belongs to HASH_WAIT_BLOCK; unselected first-block words have no source and receive zero
limitations: Does not prove reachability or sequential equivalence of the complete design
Does not claim equality of combinational next_word on disabled writes
Does not cover X/Z or an externally forced illegal hash_state encoding
Simulation result summary is bound separately to this exact recipe SHA256
